method_note: A model-agnostic perturbation technique in the same family as Shapley-value estimation: mask a region of the input and measure the model's own confidence drop for its top prediction, i.e. that region's marginal contribution. Run against the real deployed MLflow pyfunc artifacts via the actual inference contract, one representative image, 4×4 grid (16 masked variants per model).
caveat: Computed once on one sample image as a demonstration, not a comprehensive bias/fairness audit across the dataset. A single occluded cell happening to also be the true defect location is the expected, desired result — it shows the model is keying on the real signal rather than a background shortcut; it does not by itself establish fairness across aircraft, lighting, or defect size.
